changes: Single-entry extlinux boot skips the redundant menu; the U-Boot one-second abort window remains.
Three custom Zynq configurations omit NAND, parallel NOR, UBI/UBIFS, SquashFS and USB device download support.
FIT_PRINT is disabled; FIT_VERBOSE, SHA256 and FIT signature support remain.
SD, USB host storage, Ethernet and QSPI recovery commands remain. Kernel compression and cache settings are unchanged.

configuration_checks.result: passed for all three custom configurations

build_checks.scope: Three changed custom board configurations and one older-release compatibility build. Vendor Zedboard/KR260 builds are recorded in the previous report. No full OS image rebuild.

boot_bin_packaging.scope: Same FSBL and bitstream inputs as the previous report; only the U-Boot ELF changes. The previous report verified a repacked baseline BOOT.BIN matched the installed SD file byte for byte.

serial_boot_comparison.method: 115200 8N1 capture with host time.monotonic timestamps. Both 2026.01 loaders are RAM-chainloaded by the installed U-Boot, then run without serial interruption using the same SD card and unchanged kernel.itb. First modernized build uses the original extlinux file; optimized build uses the new noninteractive file. One observation per build.

remaining_boot_costs.fit_start_includes: FIT parsing, hash checks, FDT/board-overlay loading and serial output; not isolated SHA256 time.
remaining_boot_costs.kernel_load: The FIT carries zImage with compression=none. bootm loados copies the kernel; gzip decompression happens later inside zImage.
remaining_boot_costs.handoff_gap_scope: Includes U-Boot cleanup, zImage decompression and early kernel initialization through the first visible console line.

rejected_diagnostic_attempt.result: Not used for performance claims or shipped configuration. The Zynq timer_get_boot_us path reads the raw SCU counter without a defined CFG_SYS_TIMER_RATE and assumes microsecond units. The diagnostic build also failed to populate the EEPROM MAC. Normal builds and the time command measurements succeeded.

hardware_checks.method: RAM bootelf -p, ELF loaded at 0x10000000 and executed at 0x04000000. Optimized build interrupted for recovery/hash checks, then chainloaded again for automatic boot timing. Final separate staged bootm run measures command costs.
